correctness.rationale: All facets follow from bipartite connectedness, and every feasible smaller subset extends to a facet because the partition-matroid capacity is M-1 >= k. Hence the full complex equals a matroid rank-k truncation. Matroid shellability gives the integral sphere wedge. Exact augmented chains identify the skeleton top homology as exterior power of the augmentation lattice, and the pair quotient as a sign-twisted truncated augmented simplex, producing the integral equivariant sequence and ranks. A directly executed 916-case finite checker with 875 mod-2 homology cases and 916 symmetry traces corroborates the proof but does not replace it.

value.rationale: The new 2025 graph complex raises whether a connected root hypothesis is necessary. Complete bipartite graphs give a natural infinite disconnected-root family where it is unnecessary. Beyond a yes/no shellability observation, the statement gives a full classification with exact wedge multiplicities, a canonical integral equivariant sequence and all rational stabilizer characters. This precise structural information is useful for comparing rooted variants and extending to multipartite networks, not an arbitrary isolated numeric computation.
